subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB402
title: Directs the Department of State Police to maintain a staffing level of at least 20 patrol troopers per 100,000 residents of this state, beginning on January 1, 2036.
headline: SB 402 did not pass

claims.text: SB 402 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.

Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
